title: wg: room-policy-04 §5 fixed-room uniqueness across hubs unspecified
description: §5 (L530) 'only a single fixed-membership room for any unique set of participants' does not say how uniqueness is enforced across hubs or who resolves simultaneous creation (JMAP Chat federation uses min(ULID)). Fix: specify the rule. Found by the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18.
